gloss: close call; narrow escape; by a hair's breadth

definitions.gloss: close call; narrow escape; critical moment
definitions.explanation: A dangerous situation where disaster was barely avoided.

examples.japanese: {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}のところで{事故|じこ}を{免|まぬか}れた。
{電車|でんしゃ}に{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}で{間|ま}に{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I made the train by a hair's breadth.

examples.japanese: {危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}で{落下物|らっかぶつ}を{避|よ}けた。
examples.english: I dodged the falling object just in time.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
{危機|きき} (crisis) + {一髪|いっぱつ} (one hair)
Literal: "crisis of one hair" - the margin was as thin as a single hair

COLLOCATIONS:
・{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}のところで (just barely, at the last moment)
・{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}で{助|たす}かる (be saved by a hair)
・{危機一髪|ききいっぱつ}で{逃|のが}れる (escape by a hair)

TRIVIA:
The phrase emphasizes how close the danger was - separated by the width of a single hair.

SIMILAR:
・{間一髪|かんいっぱつ} - similar meaning
・{九死一生|きゅうしいっしょう} - narrow escape from death

cross_references.headword: {一触即発|いっしょくそくはつ}
